purpose: The Milestone 4 baselines beyond the pooled rate, fitted on each development fold's training blocks and scored on its test block, for the two C0-clock primary targets (decided at the regular open, when the opening gap is known) in both versions (all_event and clean_window). M2 also takes the opening gap. The holdout is sealed. loses_half_of_gap is INSUFFICIENT_DATA in the clean-window version by the protocol's thresholds, so its all-event results are exploratory. Every contrast is model minus comparator, lower is better. A status is never a claim of a tradable or production-ready edge.
